label: Regular bail application (accused in custody)

review.note: Fixed wording is a standard bail application. It has not yet been reviewed by a practising advocate. Grounds are exactly what you type; none are added.

notes: Choose the section that matches both the court and the date of the FIR. For FIRs registered on or after 1 July 2024 the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 applies; earlier FIRs continue under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Type the offences and sections exactly as written in the FIR. This tool does not look up or convert section numbers.

slots.label: Name of the court
slots.example: Court of the Principal Sessions Judge, Coimbatore

slots.label: Section the application is made under
options: Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
Section 480 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
Section 437 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
slots.example: Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023

slots.label: Father's name, with the relation, and age
slots.example: S/o Mr. Ramesh Kumar, aged 34 years

slots.label: Offences and sections as written in the FIR
Present custody (for example: remanded to judicial custody and lodged in a named prison)
slots.example: has been remanded to judicial custody and is lodged in Central Prison, Coimbatore

slots.label: Grounds for bail. Write one ground per line
slots.example:
That the applicant has been falsely implicated.
That the applicant has no previous criminal record.
That the investigation is complete and the applicant's custody is no longer required.

slots.label: What the applicant will undertake if released (optional)
slots.example: appear before the Court and the Investigating Officer whenever required

blocks.text: The State, represented by the Public Prosecutor ... Respondent
The Petitioner respectfully states as follows:
{{fir_no}} dated {{fir_date|date}} was registered at {{police_station}} for the offences: {{offences}}.
The Petitioner was arrested on {{arrest_date|date}} and {{custody_status}}.
The Petitioner is ready to furnish bail bond and surety to the satisfaction of this Court and to abide by any condition this Court may impose.
The Petitioner therefore prays that this Court may be pleased to release the Petitioner on bail in {{fir_no}} registered at {{police_station}}, on such terms and conditions as this Court deems fit.
